shorts.title: The US Really Built Bat Bombs 🦇 Meatball Investigates
shorts.description:
The US Army strapped tiny firebombs to bats. Project X-Ray: in 1942 dentist Lytle Adams pitched strapping tiny timed firebombs to Mexican free-tailed bats, and President Roosevelt approved it. On 15 May 1943 armed bats got loose and set the Carlsbad Army Airfield Auxiliary Air Base in New Mexico on fire. The program was cancelled in 1944 after about $2 million.

#meatballinvestigates #history #ww2 #learnontiktok
